text: • Apply turmeric and kumkuma to the kalasham • Fill the kalasham with water • Add akshintalu, coins, betel nut and other mangala dravyas per your family's way • Tie turmeric thread around the kalasham's neck • Arrange the mango leaves • Place the turmeric-smeared coconut on top • Tie the cloth / blouse piece • If using amma's face (mukham), fix it now • Set the kalasham on the rice-filled plate The dravyas placed in the kalasham vary by family tradition.
